guide.summary: Theatres, art museums, gardens and tango dinner shows, with parrillas, historic cafés, a bakery and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan museum days around closures: MALBA is closed on Tuesdays, Museo Evita on Mondays, Fundación PROA on Mondays and Tuesdays, and Colección Amalita opens only Thursday to Sunday.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: MALBA states 'Martes cerrado', and Colección Amalita opens Thursday to Sunday, 12:00–20:00. Fundación PROA opens Wednesday to Sunday, and Museo Evita Tuesday to Sunday.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Teatro Colón sells guided-visit tickets online and in person Monday to Saturday, 9:00–16:45, entering at Libertad 621. Bioparque Temaikèn sells tickets and visit dates online.

toolkit.label: Walk-in and queues
toolkit.copy: Colección Amalita's Spanish guided tours are free with admission and need no booking. At the Jardín Japonés, ticket sales close at 18:30, and the garden says it does not close for rain.

toolkit.label: Rules and policies
toolkit.copy: The Jardín Japonés charges residents less on showing a DNI, and children under 12 enter free with an adult. El Querandí lets you change your show date for free; cancellations get 50% back if made before 14:00 that day.

guide.dek: Anchor each day on one museum with known opening days, then book a parrilla or tango dinner show ahead for the evening.
intro: Buenos Aires rewards you for checking closing days before you set out. MALBA, at Av. Figueroa Alcorta 3415, is closed on Tuesdays. It opens 12:00–20:00 Thursday to Monday and from 11:00 on Wednesdays, and its exhibitions 'Belkis Ayón: Mito y desobediencia' and 'Viva Frida' both run until 15 March 2027. Museo Evita in Palermo opens Tuesday to Sunday, 11:00–19:00, with public guided tours at 16:00 and an English-language tour on Fridays at 15:00. Fundación PROA in La Boca opens Wednesday to Sunday, 12:00–19:00.

Colección Amalita in Puerto Madero, formerly Colección Fortabat, opens Thursday to Sunday, 12:00–20:00, and its Spanish guided tours are free with admission and need no booking. At Teatro Colón, Cerrito 628, guided visits take in the auditorium, the main foyer and the Salón Dorado. Tickets are sold online, or in person Monday to Saturday from 9:00 to 16:45 at Libertad 621. Teatro Nacional Cervantes, at Libertad 815, runs its box office Wednesday to Sunday, 10:00–22:00, and lists guided visits on its calendar.

For families, the Museo Argentino de Ciencias Naturales at Av. Ángel Gallardo 470 lists 'Exploraciones imaginarias' from 16 October to 30 November 2026. The Jardín Japonés in Parque 3 de Febrero opens daily from 10:00 to 18:45, and ticket sales end at 18:30. Children under 12 enter free with an adult, and the garden says it does not close for rain. Bioparque Temaikèn, in Escobar outside the city, sells tickets and visit dates online and advises you to check opening days first.

For eating, Don Julio in Palermo Viejo serves daily from 11:30 to 16:00 and from 19:00 to 1:00. La Cabrera, on José Antonio Cabrera, opens every day for lunch and dinner. El Cuartito on Talcahuano, a pizzería founded in 1934, opens Tuesday to Sunday. Café Tortoni on Av. de Mayo and La Biela in Recoleta both open at 8:00, which suits an early start. For tango, El Querandí, Café de los Angelitos and Rojo Tango all stage dinner shows, and El Querandí's show starts at 21:30.
summaryCards: Pair a Teatro Colón guided visit with coffee at Café Tortoni, then book a dinner show at El Querandí.
Start at La Biela or Cuervo Café in Recoleta, then walk the Jardín Japonés when it opens at 10:00.
Check closing days: MALBA is closed on Tuesdays, and Colección Amalita opens only Thursday to Sunday.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several sites could not be read: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes, Ecoparque, Palacio Libertad and Four Seasons (403), Planetario, Biblioteca Nacional and Catedral Metropolitana (certificate errors), Las Violetas (connection refused), Ninina (rate-limited) and Casa Rosada (timeout). No current official city page for Recoleta Cemetery was found, so it is omitted. Hours were not published for Florería Atlántico, Faena, the Alvear Palace venues, Atelier Fuerza, Museo de Arte Moderno and Temaikèn, and Gran Bar Danzón gives days but no times. Don Julio, La Cabrera, Gran Bar Danzón, Florería Atlántico and Café de los Angelitos showed no 2026-dated content, so they rest on published hours or booking channels. Cuervo Café publishes one chain-wide schedule rather than branch hours.
